reader.requirement: At --std 85, closing an OPTIONAL relative file opened INPUT that was not present (OPEN status 05) must succeed (00) without end-of-file processing and without creating the file or changing the file position indicator: the file stays absent, so a later OPEN INPUT answers 05 again, and the CLOSE removes the file from the open mode (a second CLOSE is 42).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: a successful WITH LOCK of the absent optional file locks the physical file at 85 (38 on the next OPEN)

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/DialectBehavior/OptionalNotPresent in FileRegistry.cs and FileConnector.cs close path; the absent-optional branch of CloseCell consults no edition (its only effect is to suppress 07, unreachable for a relative file).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb140_close_status covers an absent optional SEQUENTIAL file; the relative organization, a CLOSE after READ at end / random READ / START on the absent file, WITH LOCK and the I-O-mode creation case are exercised by this slice's probes

probes.printed: OPEN=05; EOF=10; CLOSE=00; REOPEN=05; RAND=23; START=23; CLOSE2=00; CLOSELOCK=00; AFTERLOCK=38; Q-OPEN=05; Q-CLOSE=00; Q-CLOSE2=42; Q-OPENIO=05; Q-CLOSEIO=00; Q-OPENIN=00; Q-EOF=10
probes.expected: absent optional input file: CLOSE succeeds 00 with no end-of-file processing; the file is not created (re-OPEN INPUT 05 again); a later CLOSE is 42; OPEN I-O creates it (05), after which OPEN INPUT is 00 (§1985:VIII.1.3.4 (1) c)

reader.notes: The connector of an absent optional file is in the open mode after the 05 OPEN, so CloseCell's guard passes and the plain close runs; nothing creates the file, which a re-OPEN's 05 shows. The FPI's 'unchanged' half is not observable after the close beyond this.
